notes: Density measured in dwelling units per net acre (du/ac). Fremont uses General Plan density ranges tied to zoning subdistricts. R-1 districts do not specify density in du/ac directly; density is derived from minimum lot size. R-3 subdistricts specify explicit density ranges. Commercial/mixed-use zones allow residential as part of mixed-use projects at densities governed by General Plan designations.

R-1-6.description: Single-Family Residential, 6,000 sq ft minimum lot size. Low-density single-family homes. Density derived from lot size (approx 6-7 du/ac).

R-1-6-GG.description: Single-Family Residential, Glenmoor Gardens designated neighborhood. 6,000 sq ft minimum lot size.

R-1-8.description: Single-Family Residential, 8,000 sq ft minimum lot size. Low-density single-family homes.

R-1-8-MR.description: Single-Family Residential, Mission Ranch designated neighborhood. 8,000 sq ft minimum lot size.

R-1-10.description: Single-Family Residential, 10,000 sq ft minimum lot size. Low-density single-family homes.

R-1-20.description: Single-Family Residential, 20,000 sq ft minimum lot size. Very low density, typically hillside or semi-rural areas.

R-1-40.description: Single-Family Residential, 40,000 sq ft (approx 1 acre) minimum lot size. Very low density, hillside residential.

R-2.description: Two-Family Residential (Duplex). Allows single-family and duplex dwellings. Low-medium density.

R-G.description: Garden Residential District. Recognizes developments built under garden-style standards with emphasis on open green areas. Low density, mix of housing types.

R-3-10.description: Multi-Family Residential, grandfathered density range. Properties may continue at this density until rezoned.

R-3-15.description: Multi-Family Residential, grandfathered density. Cannot be applied to new properties as of Jan 1, 2014.

R-3-27.description: Multi-Family Residential, grandfathered density. Cannot be applied to new properties as of Jan 1, 2014.

R-3-35.description: Multi-Family Residential, urban density. Up to 3 units above/below allowed for superior design.

R-3-50.description: Multi-Family Residential, urban density. Up to 4 units above/below allowed for superior design.

R-3-70.description: Multi-Family Residential, urban/transit-oriented density. Up to 5 units above/below allowed for superior design. Applies within TOD areas near BART.

CC.description: Community Commercial. General commercial uses; standalone residential not permitted.

CN.description: Neighborhood Commercial. Small-scale neighborhood-serving commercial uses; standalone residential not permitted.

CO.description: Office Commercial. Office and professional service uses; standalone residential not permitted.

CR.description: Regional Commercial. Large-scale regional retail and commercial uses; standalone residential not permitted.

MX.description: Mixed-Use District. Primarily commercial with residential above; ground floor retail/service required. Residential density per General Plan designation (medium to urban range). Vertical mixed-use encouraged.

TC-P.description: Town Center - Pedestrian. Historic cores of Centerville, Irvington, Mission San Jose, and Niles. Mixed-use, pedestrian-oriented. Residential density per General Plan designation.

TC-T.description: Town Center - Transitional. Areas transitioning from suburban to walkable mixed-use character. Residential density per General Plan designation.

D-CA.description: Downtown - Capitol Avenue Zone. Urban mixed-use along Capitol Avenue corridor. High-density residential and commercial.

D-E.description: Downtown - Edge Zone. Transitional area at downtown periphery. Medium-density residential and mixed-use.

D-CC.description: Downtown - Civic Center Zone. Government, institutional, and high-density mixed-use around civic core.

D-MD.description: Downtown - Mid Zone. Core downtown area with urban-density residential and commercial mixed-use.

CC-D.description: City Center Districts. Mixed-use development per City Center Community Plan. Urban-density residential and nonresidential.

WSI.description: Warm Springs Innovation District. Mixed-use near Warm Springs/South Fremont BART station. Urban housing, innovation/advanced manufacturing, commercial. Transit-oriented high density.

IG.description: General Industrial. Manufacturing, wholesale, distribution, and related service uses. Residential not permitted.

IL.description: Limited Industrial. Light industrial, research and development, and compatible office uses. Residential not permitted.

O-S.description: Open Space. Parks, recreation, natural resource conservation, and open space preservation. Residential not permitted.

P-F.description: Public Facilities. Government buildings, schools, utilities, and public infrastructure. Residential not permitted.

P.description: Planned District. Density determined by approved development plan and applicable General Plan designation. Allows flexible site planning within overall density limits.

AP.description: Airport (GIS short code). Airport land use. Residential not permitted.

B.description: Business/Commercial (GIS short code). General commercial/business district. Maps to CC/CN/CO/CR commercial zones. Standalone residential not permitted.

HDR.description: High Density Residential (GIS short code). Maps to R-3-30 through R-3-70 multi-family zones. Density range 23.1-70.0 du/ac.

I.description: Industrial (GIS short code). Maps to IG/IL industrial zones. Residential not permitted.

IP.description: Industrial Park (GIS short code). Maps to IL (Limited Industrial). Light industrial, R&D, and compatible office. Residential not permitted.

LDR.description: Low Density Residential (GIS short code). Maps to R-1 single-family zones (R-1-6 through R-1-40). Density 0.5-7.3 du/ac depending on lot size.

MHP.description: Mobile Home Park (GIS short code). Mobile home park residential. Medium density.

N/A.description: Not Applicable / Unzoned (GIS short code). Parcels without a designated zoning classification.

R1.description: Single-Family Residential (GIS short code). Maps to R-1 subdistricts (R-1-6, R-1-8, R-1-10, R-1-20, R-1-40). Density 0.5-7.3 du/ac depending on lot size.

R2.description: Two-Family Residential (Duplex). Allows single-family and duplex dwellings. Low-medium density.

R3.description: Multi-Family Residential (GIS short code). Maps to R-3 subdistricts (R-3-10 through R-3-70). Density 8.3-70.0 du/ac depending on subdistrict.

RHB.description: Residential/Hybrid Business (GIS short code). Maps to MX (Mixed-Use) or TC zones. Residential density 14.6-50.0 du/ac per General Plan.

TTP_CG.description: Transit-Oriented / Town Center - Commercial General (GIS short code). Maps to TC-P/TC-T Town Center zones. Mixed-use, pedestrian-oriented. 14.6-50.0 du/ac.
